title: Attribute the loaded coordination-open time left unseparated by the canonical-schema phase diagnostic

Any confirmed actionable defect is linked to its existing owner or filed with its concrete mechanism and evidence; the result distinguishes redundant work fixed by w-cf60bbf2c7e4 from unresolved loaded-time attribution.
